verdict.rationale: Automatic tax calculation and collection is a fair question for a payments provider, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents Mollie calculating or collecting sales tax, VAT, or GST. Multicurrency, application fees, and settlement reports are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can calculate and collect the correct sales tax, VAT, or GST on every transaction automatically
